name: todo-app
description: To-Do List app (MERN): Express + MongoDB API in /server, React + Tailwind UI in /client

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
